name: pipeline-trailing-stop
description: Trailing stop resolved as a percent from the extreme. A SellSignal orderKind=stopTrailing tracks a running MAX(extreme, tick.last()) seeded with the signal's own price, and fires when last retraces trailPercent% from that extreme, filling AT the trigger level. Funding 1000, zero fees, trailPercent 10. Tick script: t1 last=100 -> BuySignal market fills 10 base @100; t2 last=120 -> strategy emits SellSignal orderKind=stopTrailing price=120 trailPercent=10 (enqueued, extreme seeded 120, trigger level 120*0.9=108); t3 last=125 -> resolved before the strategy sees t3: extreme -> max(120,125)=125, trigger level 125*0.9=112.5, no fire (125>112.5); t4 last=111 -> extreme stays 125 (111<125), trigger level still 112.5, fires (111<=112.5), fills AT 112.5 -> output 1125, input 1000, pnl +125, final equity 1125.

ticks.action: strategy emits SellSignal orderKind=stopTrailing price=120 trailPercent=10 (extreme seeded 120, trigger 108)
resolves: extreme stays 125, trigger 112.5, fires (111<=112.5), fills AT 112.5
